BS-Roformer-SW.ckpt.author: jarredou
BS-Roformer-SW.ckpt.summary: The cleanest drums of any model here. Pick it when the drum stem goes into a song. A 6-stem model, about 700 MB.

htdemucs_ft.yaml.author: Meta AI
htdemucs_ft.yaml.summary: Fine-tuned Demucs v4, the best Demucs on drums. Good enough when the drum stem is only for analysis, such as BPM detection.

htdemucs.yaml.author: Meta AI
htdemucs.yaml.summary: Demucs v4 before fine-tuning. Weaker on drums than htdemucs_ft.

hdemucs_mmi.yaml.author: Meta AI
hdemucs_mmi.yaml.summary: Hybrid Demucs v3 trained on extra data. Weaker on drums than htdemucs_ft.

htdemucs_6s.yaml.author: Meta AI
htdemucs_6s.yaml.summary: Demucs v4 with guitar and piano stems added. The weakest drums of the Demucs models.

kuielab_a_drums.onnx.author: KUIELab
kuielab_a_drums.onnx.summary: MDX-Net drums model from the 2021 Music Demixing Challenge. Far weaker than the Demucs and Roformer models.

kuielab_b_drums.onnx.author: KUIELab
kuielab_b_drums.onnx.summary: MDX-Net drums model from the 2021 Music Demixing Challenge. Far weaker than the Demucs and Roformer models.
